name: MujinaControl-S19
notes: Fully routed on 2026-11-11: 0 unconnected items; DRC is clean as of 2026-11-12: 0 violations, 0 unconnected, 0 schematic parity issues; ERC 0. Reference designators are hidden on silkscreen; only the RESET and BOOT button labels remain. 323 footprints, 2021 tracks, 794 vias, all 0.45/0.30 mm; minimum track 0.127 mm. Regulator ground pours cleared of crossing signals and 153 ground stitching vias added on 2026-11-12. Tracks reviewed and cleaned on 2026-11-11 (jogs straightened, duplicate copper merged, corners chamfered, 21 nets re-routed shorter); SD clock re-matched after an outside edit. USB, Ethernet, SD card and SPI NAND are length-matched to the RV1106 guide limits. Power: 12 V input, fan supply, ground return and 5 V are zones; 3.3 V is the In2 plane with core, DDR, 5 V, 12 V and two 1.8 V islands; In3 carries slow signals. Six-layer nominal 1.6 mm, ENIG, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner. 3 A per fan, input stage for four fans plus board, 5 V system budget 2 A. Parts checked against the fab's live stock on 2026-11-12 (docs/bom-fab-stock.md): every purchased part has LCSC and MPN fields; 67 part numbers, 24 basic, 9 preferred, 34 extended; RV1106G2 needs standard assembly; low stock on Q1 (7) and the hashboard connectors J3-J5 (29); supervisors U120-U124 use a second-source part chosen for stock (6,283) and now trip at about 90 % of each rail. USB-A host port J17 with a USB switch and current-limited 5 V, and a not-fitted JTAG header J18, added on 2026-11-12 (docs/usb-host-jtag.md); the accessory header J15 is not fitted; RESET and BOOT buttons moved east. Not reviewed for manufacturing yet: the east-side hashboard lines are long (up to 117 mm) with up to 9 vias because of where their pins sit (see docs/routing-current.md). Not for ordering until reviewed. Older routing documents describe the pre-ripup board.
